changelog:
**Major update: data-viz now generates standalone SVG/HTML charts from CSV/JSON data with zero third-party dependencies.**

- Rewritten to use pure Python (no matplotlib/pandas), enabling visualization in sandboxed or restricted environments.
- Accepts CSV/JSON input; auto-detects column types and renders histograms, scatter plots, and bar charts as SVG.
- Produces a full HTML dashboard (`index.html`) and a data summary (`summary.json`).
- Adds an internal learning mechanism to track usage and improve chart recommendations over time.
- Command-line script interface: `python scripts/viz.py --data <input> --out <dir> [--topn N]`.
- Dropped legacy command-line and external tool instructions; now focused on offline, standalone charting.
summary: 数据可视化。读 CSV/JSON 数据集，自动推断列类型，纯 Python 生成 SVG 图表（直方图/散点/柱状/折线）与 HTML 看板，无 matplotlib/pandas 依赖。当用户需要"画个图""数据可视化""做个图表""看分布""dashboard"时使用。
